# Digital Asset Properties

Category-specific properties for digital assets: domains, social media, subscriptions, crypto wallets, cloud storage, NFTs, gaming accounts

Source: [`v3/asset-categories/digital.json`](../../../v3/asset-categories/digital.json)

Schema `$id`: `https://openinherit.org/v3/asset-categories/digital.json`

## Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `digitalAccess` | `object` | | Structured access information for digital assets — login credentials, 2FA, recovery methods, and platform death policies. Critical for executors managing the digital estate |
| `socialMedia` | `object` | | Social media account details for digital assets |
| `cryptoAccess` | `object` | | Cryptocurrency wallet and key access information |
| `cloudStorage` | `object` | | Cloud storage account details for digital assets — provider, usage, important folders, family photo access |
| `domainNameAccess` | `object` | | Domain name registration details — registrar, expiry, transfer locks. Critical for executors managing digital estates with web properties |
| `nftAccess` | `object` | | Non-fungible token (NFT) details — blockchain, contract, token identifier, and marketplace information |
| `monetisedContentAccess` | `object` | | Monetised online content — YouTube channels, Substack newsletters, Patreon pages, and similar revenue-generating content platforms |
| `loyaltyAccess` | `object` | | Loyalty programme points and rewards — airline miles, hotel points, retailer schemes. Some programmes permit post-death transfer; others forfeit on death |
| `gamingAccess` | `object` | | Gaming platform account details — Steam, Xbox, PlayStation, and similar platforms with virtual currencies and digital game libraries |
| `platformDelegation` | `object` | | Instructions for what should happen to a digital asset or account after death — memorialise, delete, transfer, archive, or preserve |
| `fiduciaryAccess` | `object` | | How a fiduciary (executor, personal representative) can gain lawful access to this digital asset after death |
